senses.gloss: शेव् €1 Ā. To worship; see सेव्.

सेव् €1 Ā. (सेवते, सेवित; caus. सेवयति-ते; desid.
 सिसेविषते; the स् of सेव् is generally changed to ष् after
 prepositions ending in इ such as नि, परि, वि)
—1 To serve,
[]
 wait or attend upon, honour, worship, obey; प्रायो भृत्यास्त्यजन्ति प्रचलितविभवं
 स्वामिनं सेवमानाः Mu. 4. 21; आचारपूतं पवनः सिषेवे R. 2. 13
 ‘served or refreshed’; ऐश्वर्यादनपेतमीश्वरमयं लोकोऽर्थतः सेवते Mu. 1. 14.
—2 To go after, pursue, follow.
—3 To use, enjoy; किं सेव्यते सुमनसां मनसापि गन्धः कस्तूरिकाजननशक्तिभृता मृगेण R. G.
—4 To enjoy carnally; केतकीं सेवसे हन्त कथं रोलम्ब निस्त्रपः Bv. 1. 118.
—5 To attach or devote oneself to, attend to, cultivate, practise, perform;
 विद्वद्भिः सेवितः (धर्मः) Ms. 2. 1; त्वया मनोनिर्विषयार्थकामया
 यदेक एव प्रतिगृह्य सेव्यते Ku. 5. 38; R. 17. 49.
—6 To resort to, betake oneself to, dwell in, frequent, inhabit; तप्तं
 वारि विहाय तीरनलिनीं कारण्डवः सेवते V. 2. 23; Pt. 1. 9.
—7 To watch over, guard, protect.

शेवः [शुक्रपाते सति शेते, शी-वन् Uṇ. 1. 152, 154]
—1 The penis.
—2 A snake.
—3 Height, elevation.
—4 Happiness.
—5 Wealth, treasure.
—6 An epithet of Agni.
—7 Of Soma.

शेवः + .{@-वम्@}
—1 The penis (also शेवा).
—2 Happiness.
—3 Hail! (exclamation addressed to deities).
.━{@Comp.@}: शेवधिः

शेवलम् [शी-विच् तथा भूतः सन् वलते वल्-अच् Tv.]
—1 The green moss-like substance growing on the surface of water.
—2 A kind of plant.
शेवलिनी A river.
शेवाल See शेवल.
सेव See सेवन, सेवि (2).

सेवा [सेव्-अ]
—1 Service, servitude, dependence; attendance; सेवां लाघवकारिणीं कृतधियः
 स्थाने श्ववृत्तिं विदुः Mu. 3. 14; हीनसेवा न कर्तव्या H. 3. 11.
—2 Worship, homage, honouring.
—3 Addiction or devotion to, fondness for.
—4 Use, practice, employment, exercise.
—5 Frequenting, resorting to. —6 Flattery, coaxing or flattering words;
 अलं सेवया मध्यस्थतां गृहीत्वा भण M. 3.
.━{@Comp.@}: सेवाकार, सेवाकाकुः, सेवाधर्मः, सेवाविलासिनी, सेवावृत्तिः, सेवाव्यवहारः

सेवक a. [सेव्-ण्वुल्]
—1 Serving, worshipping, honouring.
—2 Practising, following.
—3 Dependent, servile.

सेवक + .{@-कः@}
—1 A servant, dependant; सेवया धनमिच्छद्भिः सेवकैः पश्य किं कृतम् ।
 स्वातन्त्र्यं यच्छरीरस्य मूढैस्तदपि हारितम् ॥ H. 2. 20.
—2 A votary, worshipper.
—3 A sewer.
—4 A sack.

सेवनम् [सिव्-सेव्-ल्युट्]
—1 The act of serving, service, attendance upon, worship; पात्रीकृतात्मा
 गुरुसेवनेन R. 18. 30; Pt. 1. 11.
—2 Following, practising, employing; इन्द्रियाणां प्रसङ्गेन धर्मस्यासेवनेन
 च । पापान् संयान्ति संसारानविद्वांसो नराधमाः ॥ Ms. 12. 52.
—3 Using, enjoying.
—4 Enjoying carnally; यत् करोत्येकरात्रेण वृषलीसेवनाद् द्विजः Ms. 11. 178.
—5 Devotion to, fondness for.
—6 Frequenting, dwelling in.
—7 Binding, fastening.
—8 Sewing, stitching.
—9 A sack.
सेवनी The Indian white rose.

सेवना See सेवनम् (1); तानेव ते मदनुसेवनयावरुद्धान्
 Bhāg. 3. 23. 7.

—1 A needle.
—2 A seam.
—3 A suture or seam-like union of parts of the body.

सेवा + -आकार a. in the form of servitude; सेवाकारा परिणतिरहो
 स्त्रीषु कष्टोऽधिकारः V. 3. 1.

सेवा + -काकुः change of voice in service; (this is a variant in V. 3. 1
 for सेवाकारा).

सेवा + -धर्मः
—1 the duty of service; सेवाधर्मः परमगहनो योगिनामप्यगम्यः Pt. 1. 285.
—2 the obligations of service.
सेवा + -विलासिनी a female servant.
सेवा + -वृत्तिः a livelihood gained by service.
सेवा + -व्यवहारः the practice or law of service.

सेवि n.
—1 The jujube.
—2 An apple.

सेवित^1 p. p. [सेव्-क्त]
—1 Served, attended upon, worshipped.
—2 Followed, practised, pursued.
—3 Frequented
[]
 by, resorted to, inhabited by, haunted by; वरं वनं व्याघ्रगजादिसोवितम् Pt. 5. 23.
—4 Protected, preserved.
—5 Enjoyed, used.
—6 Abounding in.
[1] Correction submitted by on 20170203. note: particple is adjective so no anusvAra.

सेवित + .{@-ता@} Service, attendance.
.━{@Comp.@}: सेवितमन्मथ
सेवित + -मन्मथ a. addicted to love.
सेवितृ m. An attendant, a dependant; न सेव्यः सेविता रहः M. 4. 12.

सेविन् a.
—1 Serving, worshipping.
—2 Following, using.
—3 Inhabiting, dwelling.
—4 Having sexual intercourse with.
—5 Addicted to, fond of. ━m. A servant.

सेव्य a. [सेव्-ण्यत्]
—1 To be served or waited upon.
—2 To be used or employed.
—3 To be enjoyed.
—4 To be taken care of or guarded.
—5 To be studied. —6 To be kept or hoarded.

सेव्य + .{@-व्यः@}
—1 A master (opp. सेवक); भयं तावत् सेव्यादभिनिविशते सेवकजनम्
 Mu. 5. 12; M. 4. 12; Pt. 1. 48.
—2 The Aśvattha tree.
—3 A sparrow.
—4 A kind of intoxicating drink.

सेव्य + .{@-व्यम्@}
—1 A kind of root.
—2 Red sandal-wood.
—3 Sea-salt.
—4 Water.
.━{@Comp.@}: सेव्यसेवकौ
सेव्य + -सेवकौ m. dual master and servant.
सेवधि See शेवधि under शेव.

—1 A maid servant.
—2 A kind of sweetmeat (Mar. फेणी).
